de4beaf9c5834c50cd06b8fd7e31ba973b19240b.summary: WIRED news article (published 2019-07-11) on Magecart, a group of hackers that steals credit card numbers, often by skimming card data from ecommerce sites. The article says the group has hit 17,000 domains in a few months by casting a wide net for vulnerable sites. It names British Airways and Ticketmaster among past hacks and warns the method could lead to even bigger problems.

dea766dd933827008dbafa083e0e49353ca752bf.summary: Juniper Threat Labs describes the Sysrv botnet, which spreads by exploiting known vulnerabilities in web and enterprise software and installs a Monero cryptominer based on XMRig. In March 2021 it merged its worm and miner into one binary, added a new mining pool, and began adding SSH keys to infected systems for persistence. The report lists the bundled exploits, the mining pools and wallet earnings, and indicators of compromise.
